notes: This package is ready for local RAG-style retrieval using cosine similarity over L2-normalized TF-IDF vectors.
For production semantic RAG with OpenAI, re-embed chunks with an embedding model such as text-embedding-3-small or upload the source file to an OpenAI Vector Store.
The current environment cannot call external embedding APIs without credentials, so no OpenAI-hosted vector_store_id was created.
